learn.title: Kingdom School
learn.coreCurriculumSubtitle: The P2P Core Curriculum is the foundational discipleship journey of the Peer to Peer Global Discipleship Network — prayerfully developed under the guidance of the Holy Spirit, and firmly anchored in the authority of Scripture. It exists to establish believers in Christ, form them toward spiritual maturity, and raise disciple-makers who carry Kingdom influence into every sphere of society.
learn.coreCurriculumSubtitleQuote: Founded on God's Word. Guided by the Holy Spirit. Built to make disciples.
learn.plansSubtitle: Every P2P Study Plan is rooted in the authority of God's Word and prayerfully developed to equip believers for Christ-centered discipleship. Inspired by the faithful teachings of trusted pastors, teachers, evangelists, and Christian leaders, each plan transforms biblical truth into an original learning journey that encourages spiritual maturity, practical obedience, and Kingdom influence.

myGrowth.title: My Growth
myGrowth.vision: Everyone is learning from someone and helping someone grow.
myGrowth.intro: Explore what has been verified on P2P Global: the learning your roots are built from, what you put into practice, the people you helped and how you took part over time.
myGrowth.motto: Deep roots. Growing branches. Fruit for others.

stage.looksNote: A full-looking tree or many fruit never changes your stage. Only your verified milestones do.

treeGrows.title: How My Tree Grows
treeGrows.vision: Everyone is learning from someone and helping someone grow.
treeGrows.intro: Your tree tells the story of your growth on P2P Global. An apple tree's natural development, from seed to ripe fruit, helps explain what you have achieved, what is growing now and what comes next.
treeGrows.honest: Your Growth Stage comes only from your verified milestones in the Growth Matrix. The tree illustrates them; it never decides them. None of this measures your faith, your relationship with God or your worth.
treeGrows.unavailableBody: Your growth information couldn't load, so nothing is shown rather than numbers that might be wrong.
treeGrows.localCopy: Local review copy — not yet published in the app.
treeGrows.modelNotAvailable: This model isn't available yet. Its explanation is still here.

journey.legacy: Recognised from the previous growth system
journey.highest: Forest Builder is the highest personal stage. Forest of Nations is the whole community's forest, never a personal stage.

meaning.1: You are at the beginning. Like a seed sending down its first root, your foundations are starting to form as you take part, learn and put learning into practice.
meaning.2: Your first steady growth is visible. Like a sprout with its first leaves above a fan of fine roots, your rhythm of learning, practice and helping others has begun.
meaning.3: You are becoming established. Like a young tree with a slender trunk and open branches, your roots are deepening and you have begun helping others grow.
meaning.4: Your growth is bearing fruit. Like a mature apple tree with a full canopy, your contributions are helping others learn, and someone you helped is now helping others too.
meaning.5: Your roots run deep. Like a veteran apple tree, your foundations are established and the people you helped are helping others in turn.

process.intro: Every step of an apple tree's natural development, and what it illustrates in your journey. Open any step to see it in 3D. Opening a step never marks it as achieved.

seed.title: Seed and roots
seed.intro: Everything begins below ground. Roots illustrate your learning foundations.

buds.title: Buds and shoots
buds.intro: Each spring, growth starts from buds formed the year before. They illustrate new, recent development.

leaves.title: Leaves
leaves.intro: Leaves feed the tree through the growing season. They illustrate steady, meaningful participation.

blossom.title: Blossom
blossom.intro: Apple blossom opens in spring. It illustrates growth coming together towards your next stage.

fruit.title: From fruitlet to ripe apple
fruit.intro: Through the summer an apple grows, sweetens and changes colour. Fruit illustrates verified contributions to other people's learning.

asset_00_germinating_seed.name: Germinating seed
asset_00_germinating_seed.botany: The seed coat splits and the first root grows downward.
asset_00_germinating_seed.meaning: This is the beginning of your growth journey on P2P Global. As you start taking part, learning and putting learning into practice, your first foundations begin to form.

asset_micro_5_active_root_tip.name: Active root tip
asset_micro_5_active_root_tip.botany: The pale, growing tip of a root takes up water and nutrients.
asset_micro_5_active_root_tip.meaning: The beginning of deeper learning foundations. Each lesson, story chapter or plan session you pass, with its assessment reviewed by a peer, strengthens your roots. Opening or reading content alone doesn't count.

extra_roots_young.name: Young roots
extra_roots_young.botany: Fine roots spread out from a central taproot.
extra_roots_young.meaning: Your learning foundations becoming established through continued learning. This illustrates the learning you need for Sprout.

extra_roots_established.name: Established roots
extra_roots_established.botany: Woody lateral roots anchor the tree, with fine rootlets feeding it.
extra_roots_established.meaning: A stronger foundation, built through sustained learning. This illustrates the learning you need for Young Tree and Fruitful Tree.

extra_roots_deep.name: Deep roots
extra_roots_deep.botany: An old tree's roots form a wide, deep web that holds it through storms and drought.
extra_roots_deep.meaning: Deep, established foundations. This illustrates the learning you need for Forest Builder, including every Kingdom School Foundations lesson. Learning alone doesn't make a Forest Builder: the other three dimensions are needed too.

asset_micro_6_dormant_winter_bud.name: Dormant winter bud
asset_micro_6_dormant_winter_bud.botany: In winter the buds rest under protective scales. Resting is part of the year, not a sign of decline.
asset_micro_6_dormant_winter_bud.meaning: Seasons of rest are part of every journey. A pause, or a quieter time, never takes away what you have achieved or lowers your stage.

asset_micro_1_green_tip_bud.name: Green tip
asset_micro_1_green_tip_bud.botany: In early spring the bud scales part and the first green leaf tips show.
asset_micro_1_green_tip_bud.meaning: New development becoming visible. A green tip appears on your tree for two weeks after one of your contributions is verified.

asset_micro_3_unfurling_shoot_tip.name: Unfurling shoot
asset_micro_3_unfurling_shoot_tip.botany: New shoots lengthen and their leaves unfold.
asset_micro_3_unfurling_shoot_tip.meaning: Continued development. A new shoot appears on your tree for two weeks after you reach a new stage.

asset_06_fruiting_spur_socket.name: Fruiting spur
asset_06_fruiting_spur_socket.botany: Short woody shoots where an apple tree carries its blossom and fruit year after year.
asset_06_fruiting_spur_socket.meaning: The areas of P2P where your growth bears fruit. A fruiting branch appears for each area where you have verified evidence, such as learning, Family or Study Together.

asset_07_single_leaf_particle.name: A single leaf
asset_07_single_leaf_particle.botany: An apple leaf: oval, finely toothed at the edge, with a clear network of veins.
asset_07_single_leaf_particle.meaning: One week of meaningful participation. A week with at least one meaningful activity is an active week; more activity in the same week doesn't add weeks.

extra_leaf_cluster_small.name: Leaves on a twig
extra_leaf_cluster_small.botany: Leaves grow in small clusters along the shoots and spurs.
extra_leaf_cluster_small.meaning: A rhythm of taking part beginning to form. This illustrates the active weeks you need for Sprout.

extra_leaf_cluster_dense.name: Dense foliage
extra_leaf_cluster_dense.botany: By summer the canopy is full of overlapping leaves.
extra_leaf_cluster_dense.meaning: Sustained participation over months. This illustrates the recent active weeks you need for Young Tree and Fruitful Tree.

asset_micro_9_golden_autumn_leaf.name: Autumn leaf
asset_micro_9_golden_autumn_leaf.botany: In autumn the leaves turn golden and fall as the tree prepares to rest. It is a season, not a loss.
asset_micro_9_golden_autumn_leaf.meaning: Every journey has seasons. Leaves on your tree never fall because you were less active, and nothing you've achieved is taken away.

asset_micro_2_pink_bud_cluster.name: Pink bud cluster
asset_micro_2_pink_bud_cluster.botany: Flower buds separate and show pink before they open.
asset_micro_2_pink_bud_cluster.meaning: Development approaching a new milestone. This shows how many of your next stage's requirements are already met, and which are still outstanding.

asset_micro_7_balloon_stage_bud.name: Balloon bud
asset_micro_7_balloon_stage_bud.botany: The petals swell like a balloon just before the flower opens.
asset_micro_7_balloon_stage_bud.meaning: A contribution that has been submitted and is waiting to be verified. It shows on your tree as a closed bud, never as fruit, until it is verified.

asset_apple_blossoms.name: Blossom
asset_apple_blossoms.botany: Open blossom: white and pale pink petals around yellow stamens.
asset_apple_blossoms.meaning: Established foundations and steady development leading to visible outcomes. This shows how many of the four dimensions are met for your next stage. Blossom never awards a stage by itself.

asset_micro_4_petal_fall_fruitlet.name: Petal fall
asset_micro_4_petal_fall_fruitlet.botany: Petals drop, and pollinated flowers begin to form tiny fruit.
asset_micro_4_petal_fall_fruitlet.meaning: The move from building your own foundations to helping others. It begins with your first contribution to someone else's learning.

asset_apple_stage_1_fruitlet.name: Fruitlet
asset_apple_stage_1_fruitlet.botany: A tiny green apple, just formed.
asset_apple_stage_1_fruitlet.meaning: Your first verified contribution: the first fruit on your tree.

asset_micro_8_june_drop_fruitlet.name: June drop
asset_micro_8_june_drop_fruitlet.botany: In early summer the tree naturally sheds some fruitlets so the rest can grow well. It is thinning, not failure.
asset_micro_8_june_drop_fruitlet.meaning: Not every contribution becomes fruit. One that isn't verified simply leaves no fruit. It is never a failure and never takes anything away.

asset_04c_young_green_applelet.name: Young applelet
asset_04c_young_green_applelet.botany: The young apple swells and firms.
asset_04c_young_green_applelet.meaning: Contribution becoming part of your rhythm. This illustrates the verified contributions you need for Sprout.

asset_apple_stage_2_green.name: Green apple
asset_apple_stage_2_green.meaning: Continued, meaningful contribution to other people's growth. This illustrates the verified contributions you need for Young Tree.

asset_apple_stage_3_yellow_green.name: Turning yellow-green
asset_apple_stage_3_yellow_green.botany: As it ripens, starch turns to sugar and the skin begins to change colour.
asset_apple_stage_3_yellow_green.meaning: Helping others in a lasting way. This illustrates what Fruitful Tree needs: more verified contributions, a learner you supported over months who went on to develop, and someone you helped who now helps others.

asset_apple_stage_4_golden_yellow.name: Golden
asset_apple_stage_4_golden_yellow.botany: Golden colour shows as the apple nears ripeness.
asset_apple_stage_4_golden_yellow.meaning: Contribution that multiplies. This illustrates what Forest Builder needs: sustained support of a learner, and people you helped who keep helping others.

asset_04d_blushed_apple.name: Blushed
asset_04d_blushed_apple.botany: In sunlight many varieties develop a red blush.
asset_04d_blushed_apple.meaning: One of the ripe varieties on your tree. Each ripe fruit is one verified contribution; which variety it shows carries no meaning.

asset_apple_stage_5_ripe_red.name: Ripe
asset_apple_stage_5_ripe_red.meaning: A verified contribution that has reached its completed state. Each ripe fruit on your tree is one verified contribution; a group session you led is one fruit. Ripe fruit is not a promotion by itself.

asset_apple_stage_6_striped_red.name: Striped variety
asset_apple_stage_6_striped_red.botany: Some varieties ripen with red and gold stripes.
asset_apple_stage_6_striped_red.meaning: Another ripe variety on your tree. Like every ripe fruit, it is one verified contribution, and its look carries no meaning.

p2pPlans.title: P2P Plans
p2pPlans.intro: Plans help you study a Bible book, a topic or a course at your own pace, on your own or together. The resources stay where they are; a plan organises them.
p2pPlans.learningPlansHint: The Learning Centre's topic plans, categories, saved and completed plans — all as before.
p2pPlans.continueEmpty: You aren't following a plan yet. Explore the plans below or create your own.
p2pPlans.searchPlaceholder: Type a word, a book or a topic
p2pPlans.noMatch: No plan matches. Try another word, or create your own plan.

detail.questionsYes: Included for each session — you can hide them any time
detail.noExam: No examination is needed to start or finish a plan. Lessons keep their own assessments in Kingdom School.
detail.growthNote: Completing a session is your own plan record. It doesn't award Growth Matrix credit — lessons count only through their own assessment.
detail.derivedNote: These are the real Kingdom School lessons, in curriculum order. A session is complete when its lesson is complete.
detail.notOfficial: This plan was created by a participant. It isn't official P2P curriculum.
